extName.description: 扩展名称，显示在 Chrome 应用商店和 chrome://extensions 中。两种语言保持一致，不要翻译。

extDescription.message: 把知乎专栏、回答、问题页和热榜转换为 Markdown，保留公式、代码和图片，一键下载或复制。
extDescription.description: 扩展简介，显示在 Chrome 应用商店和 chrome://extensions 中。不超过 132 个字符。

cmdExportPage.description: 快捷键说明（Alt+Shift+K），显示在 chrome://extensions/shortcuts。

menuPageExport.description: 右键菜单：在知乎可导出页面上导出本页。

menuPageCopy.description: 右键菜单：复制本页为 Markdown 到剪贴板。

menuSelectionCopy.description: 右键菜单：把选中的内容复制为 Markdown。

menuLinkExport.message: 导出链接的知乎页面为 Markdown
menuLinkExport.description: 右键菜单：在知乎问题、回答或专栏链接上，打开并导出该页。

ballTooltipIdlePart1.description: First half of the idle tooltip, kept on one line, ending with "·". A space separates it from the second half; narrow screens wrap only there.

ballTooltipIdlePart2.description: Second half of the idle tooltip, kept on one line.

ballTooltipIdle.message: 点击下载 · 右键复制

ballAriaIdle.message: 导出 Markdown（点击下载，右键复制）
ballAriaIdle.description: Floating ball accessible name (aria-label) when idle.

ballLoadingContent.description: Floating ball: loading content before exporting a question page or feed.

ballExportingHot.description: Floating ball: exporting the hot list.

ballDownloadingImages.description: Floating ball: exporting with image download turned on.

ballExportedImagesFailed.message: 已导出，$ARG1$ 张图片未能下载，已保留在线链接
ballExportedImagesFailed.description: Floating ball: export succeeded but some images failed. $1 = number of images (2 or more).

ballExportedImagesFailedOne.message: 已导出，$ARG1$ 张图片未能下载，已保留在线链接
ballExportedImagesFailedOne.description: Singular form of ballExportedImagesFailed, used when the count is 1. $1 = 1.

ballExportedImagesKept.message: 已导出，$ARG1$ 张图片保留为在线链接
ballExportedImagesKept.description: Tooltip after export when some images were kept as online links and none failed. $1 = number of images (2 or more).

ballExportedImagesKeptOne.message: 已导出，$ARG1$ 张图片保留为在线链接
ballExportedImagesKeptOne.description: Singular form of ballExportedImagesKept, used when the count is 1. $1 = 1.

ballNoSelection.message: 没有选中内容，先选中一段文字再复制
ballNoSelection.description: Floating ball: copy selection was used with nothing selected.

ballPartial.message: 部分导出：已导出 $ARG1$/$ARG2$ 条，$ARG3$ 条未能加载
ballPartial.description: Floating ball: partial export warning. $1 = exported, $2 = total, $3 = not loaded.

ballImagesFailed.message: $ARG1$ 张图片未能下载，已保留在线链接
ballImagesFailed.description: Screen reader extra: some images couldn't be downloaded. $1 = number of images (2 or more).

ballImagesFailedOne.message: $ARG1$ 张图片未能下载，已保留在线链接
ballImagesFailedOne.description: Singular form of ballImagesFailed, used when the count is 1. $1 = 1.

ballImagesFailedKept.message: $ARG1$ 张图片未能下载，$ARG2$ 张不支持保存，均已保留在线链接
ballImagesFailedKept.description: Screen reader extra when some images failed to download AND others can't be saved locally (PM copy 2026-10-29). $1 = failed count (2 or more), $2 = kept count.

ballImagesFailedKeptOne.message: $ARG1$ 张图片未能下载，$ARG2$ 张不支持保存，均已保留在线链接
ballImagesFailedKeptOne.description: Singular form of ballImagesFailedKept, used when the failed count is 1. $1 = 1, $2 = kept count.

ballImagesKept.message: $ARG1$ 张图片保留为在线链接
ballImagesKept.description: Screen reader extra: images kept as online links. $1 = number of images (2 or more).

ballImagesKeptOne.message: $ARG1$ 张图片保留为在线链接
ballImagesKeptOne.description: Singular form of ballImagesKept, used when the count is 1. $1 = 1.

ballImagesKeptMore.message: 另有 $ARG1$ 张保留为在线链接
ballImagesKeptMore.description: Screen reader extra: images kept as links in addition to the failed ones. $1 = number of images.

ballImagesKeptMoreOne.message: 另有 $ARG1$ 张保留为在线链接
ballImagesKeptMoreOne.description: Singular form of ballImagesKeptMore, used when the count is 1. $1 = 1.

ballImagesKeptReason.message: 图片格式或来源不支持保存到本地
ballImagesKeptReason.description: Screen reader extra: why images were kept as online links.

ballReasonSep.description: Screen reader: ends the kept-images sentence before the reason, so the reason is its own sentence (period; keep the trailing space in English).

ballSep.description: Screen reader: separator between two phrases (comma, keep the trailing space in English).

ballPartialSep.description: Screen reader: separator between the partial-export summary and the image details (semicolon).

ballAriaLoading.description: Floating ball accessible name while exporting. $1 = current step.

ballAriaWait.description: Floating ball accessible name while exporting when there is no step text.

ballAriaDone.description: Floating ball accessible name after success or partial export. $1 = result.

ballAriaSuccess.description: Floating ball accessible name after success when there is no result text.

ballAriaError.description: Floating ball accessible name on failure. $1 = reason.

ballAriaErrorDefault.description: Floating ball accessible name on failure when there is no reason.

failSecurityCheck.message: 被知乎限流或需要验证：请在知乎页面完成验证，或稍等几分钟后刷新再导出
failSecurityCheck.description: Floating ball failure reason: rate limited or security check.

failLoginRequired.message: 需要登录知乎才能查看这部分内容，请登录后重新导出
failLoginRequired.description: Floating ball failure reason: sign-in required.

failNotLoaded.message: 页面未加载完，请等几秒或刷新页面后再试
failNotLoaded.description: Floating ball failure reason: page not fully loaded.

failClipboard.message: 无法写入剪贴板：请保持弹窗打开后重试，或改用“导出 Markdown”
failClipboard.description: Floating ball failure reason: clipboard write failed (same text as the popup).

failExportUnknown.message: 导出失败，请刷新知乎页面后重试
failExportUnknown.description: Floating ball failure reason: unknown export error.

failCopyUnknown.message: 复制失败，请刷新知乎页面后重试
failCopyUnknown.description: Floating ball failure reason: unknown copy error.
